64ed454c69.q: What regulatory changes are driving freight industry capacity constraints through 2027 and 2028?
64ed454c69.a: The industry has faced compiling regulatory pressures including English language proficiency requirements, cracking down on chameleon carriers and CDL mills, non-domicile issues, and major changes from the Montgomery versus Caravee case. The landscape is expected to look different throughout 2027 and 2028, driving the capacity constraints discussed over the past couple of months.
